quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.plains.sheep.t: The common's grazed down to nothing but weeds and we've no flock to keep it short. Bring me %1$s %2$s on a lead, please.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.plains.hay.tex: Winter's coming and the hayloft's half empty. %1$s %2$s would see the animals through.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.plains.eggs.te: There's a feast coming and not an egg in the village. %1$s %2$s, if you can find them.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.desert.camel.t: Our caravan leaves soon, a camel short. Bring me %1$s %2$s on a lead and you'll be remembered in the songs. Probably.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.desert.water.t: The well's running low and the gardens are thirsty. %1$s %2$s would help more than you know.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.desert.hides.t: The wind's torn the tents again. %1$s %2$s will patch them.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.savanna.cattle: Something got into the kraal and half the herd is gone. Bring %1$s %2$s on a lead to fill the kraal.
We've more to carry than backs to carry it. %1$s %2$s on a lead, please.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.savanna.acacia: The fences are falling over and the goats know it. %1$s %2$s to mend them.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.snow.goat.text: The cold's dried up our old nanny. %1$s %2$s on a lead would keep the children in milk.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.snow.coal.text: It's a long, cold night up here. %1$s %2$s for the hearths.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.snow.stew.text: The ice fishers come home frozen through. %1$s %2$s would thaw them out.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.taiga.pigs.tex: The pen's empty and the smokehouse is cold. %1$s %2$s on a lead, please.
Jam-making day, and not a berry picked. %1$s %2$s from the bushes in the woods.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.taiga.firewood: The woodpile won't last the month. %1$s %2$s, split or not.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.jungle.chicken: The ocelots got the hens. Again. %1$s %2$s on a lead, and we'll build a better coop.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.jungle.cocoa.t: Traders are coming for cocoa and we've none dried. %1$s %2$s, quickly.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.jungle.melon.t: It's too hot to think. %1$s %2$s would cool everyone down.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.swamp.frog.tex: The flies are unbearable since the frogs left. %1$s %2$s on a lead, if a frog can be led.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.swamp.slime.te: Don't ask what it's for. %1$s %2$s, in a jar if you have one.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.swamp.lilies.t: The herbalist wants %1$s %2$s for a poultice. Or a hat. It's not clear.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.plains.cat.tex: LOST: grey cat, one white paw. Answers to nothing. Probably asleep somewhere warm. Reward: gratitude.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.plains.dance.t: Harvest dance at the bell, sundown. Bring a partner, or a pie.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.desert.well.te: The well is for DRINKING. Not bathing. You know who you are.
Found by the dunes: one sandal, left foot. The owner may ask at the bell.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.savanna.crossi: Mind the cattle crossing at the river. They do not mind you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.savanna.tale.t: The old tale is told tonight under the big acacia. Children sit at the front. Elders at the back, to sleep.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.snow.ice.title: Thin Ice
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.snow.ice.text: The ice on the pond is THIN. Stay off it. Yes, you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.snow.mitten.te: Lost: one red mitten, left hand. The right one is very lonely.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.taiga.fox.text: A fox has been in the henhouse every night this week. If it's yours, take it home.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.taiga.timber.t: Woodcutters: shout before it falls. The bakery roof has had enough.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.jungle.parrots: Do NOT feed the parrots. They will not leave. They will never leave.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.jungle.melon_t: Missing: one whole melon, from the market. No questions asked if it comes back.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.swamp.hut.text: The hut out in the bog is OFF LIMITS. Whatever she's selling, don't buy it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.swamp.boot.tex: Lost in the mud: one good boot. The mud won't give it back. Neither will the frogs.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.errand_lore: Pull it off the board to take the errand.

quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.help.lore: Pull it off the board to take the job.
